blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
In logistics, small words decide big things. Words like "he", "she", "we" and "they" tell the driver exactly who does what. These are personal pronouns.

We use pronouns to replace names. First we say the name. After that, we use a pronoun. For example: "Oliver is a supervisor. He works the morning shift." We say "it" for a truck, a delivery or the warehouse.

Clear pronouns mean clear instructions. On the radio, there is no time for long sentences. One wrong pronoun can delay a truck. So the team learns them well.

items.q: What do personal pronouns tell the driver?
items.why: "...tell the driver exactly who does what."

items.q: When do we use a pronoun?
options: After the first mention of the name
items.why: "First we say the name. After that, we use a pronoun."

items.q: Which pronoun do we use for a truck?
items.why: "We say 'it' for a truck, a delivery or the warehouse."

items.q: The text suggests that on the radio the team must be…
items.why: Inferência: "there is no time for long sentences" mostra que a comunicação precisa ser curta e clara.

items.q: Why does the team learn pronouns well?
options: Because a wrong pronoun can delay a truck
items.why: Inferência: "One wrong pronoun can delay a truck. So the team learns them well."

blocks.instruction: Ouça Oliver apresentar o time de logística para um novo colega. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi! Welcome to the team. Let me show you who is who.

That man over there is Marco. He is a loader. He puts the boxes on the truck. He works the morning shift.

The woman next to him is Sofia. She is a planner. She plans the routes for the day. She is very fast.

And here is Tom. He is the supervisor. He checks the trucks and the deliveries. When we have a problem, we talk to him.

You and I are colleagues now. We work together in the afternoon shift. They — Marco and Sofia — work in the morning. So we do not meet them every day.

See that big blue truck? It is number twelve. It is old, but it is good. We use it for the long deliveries.

Any questions? Just ask me. I am always near the radio.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What is Marco's job?
items.why: "That man over there is Marco. He is a loader."

items.q: What does Sofia do?
options: She puts boxes on the truck
items.why: "She is a planner. She plans the routes for the day."

items.q: Which shift does the new colleague work?
items.why: "We work together in the afternoon shift."

items.q: Why do Oliver and the new colleague NOT meet Marco and Sofia every day?
options: Because they work a different shift
items.why: Inferência: Marco e Sofia trabalham de manhã e o novo colega de tarde, então quase não se cruzam.

items.q: What can we say about truck number twelve?
options: It is only for short trips
It is old but still useful
items.why: Inferência: "It is old, but it is good. We use it for the long deliveries."

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "The loader put the last box on the truck." A loader is a person who…
items.why: Loader = carregador, quem coloca as caixas no caminhão.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "When there is a problem, we call the ___, and he decides what to do."
items.why: Supervisor = supervisor, quem toma a decisão sobre o time.

items.q: "Sofia is our planner." A planner is a person who…
options: plans the routes and the day
items.why: Planner = planejador, quem organiza as rotas e o dia.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Marco is my ___. We work together every day."
items.why: Colleague = colega de trabalho, alguém que trabalha com você.

items.q: "I work the morning shift." A shift is…
options: a work period, like morning or afternoon
items.why: Shift = turno, o período de trabalho (manhã, tarde, noite).

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no dia a dia do armazém. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The supervisor has to sign off on the delivery before it leaves." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar, dar o "ok" final.

items.q: "We roll out the new route next week." To roll out means to…
items.why: Roll out = começar a usar algo novo, colocar em prática.

items.q: "Please follow up on the late truck." To follow up means to…
items.why: Follow up = dar continuidade, verificar de novo mais tarde.

items.q: "Two loaders called in sick today." This means they…
options: phoned to say they are ill
items.why: Call in sick = ligar avisando que está doente e não vai trabalhar.

items.q: "Can you fill in for Marco this afternoon?" To fill in for someone means to…
options: do their job while they are away
items.why: Fill in for = substituir alguém, fazer o trabalho no lugar da pessoa.
